result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred insurance types and limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. The existing force-majeure language is unchanged. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is broader than necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage.
